system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: REDUCE-IT NCT01492361 - A Study of AMR101 to Evaluate Its Ability to Reduce Cardiovascular Events in High-Risk Patients With Hypertriglyceridemia and on Statin
Investigational drug: icosapent ethyl
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01492361 REDUCE-IT (registry, published 2011-12-15, source ctgov:NCT01492361@2018-09-24)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT01492361 (REDUCE-IT)
Title: A Study of AMR101 to Evaluate Its Ability to Reduce Cardiovascular Events in High-Risk Patients With Hypertriglyceridemia and on Statin
Official title: Evaluation of the Effect of AMR101 on Cardiovascular Health and Mortality in Hypertriglyceridemic Patients With Cardiovascular Disease or at High Risk for Cardiovascular Disease: REDUCE-IT (Reduction of Cardiovascular Events With EPA - Intervention Trial)
Sponsor: Amarin Pharma Inc.
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Cardiovascular Diseases
Interventions: AMR101 (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG); Statin therapy (DRUG)
Start date: 2011-11
Enrollment: 8179 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Composite of CV Death, Nonfatal MI (Including Silent MI), Nonfatal Stroke, Coronary Revascularization, or Unstable Angina Determined to be Caused by Myocardial Ischemia by Invasive / Non-invasive Testing and Requiring Emergent Hospitalization. [Total follow-up time of up to approximately 6 years.]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and non-pregnant or sterile women ages 45 and older
* Hypertriglyceridemia
* On statin therapy for at least four weeks
* Either having established cardiovascular disease or at high risk for cardiovascular disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe heart failure
* Any life-threatening disease other than cardiovascular disease
* Active severe liver disease
* Hemoglobin A1c \>10.0%
* Poorly controlled hypertension
* Planned coronary intervention (such as stent placement or heart bypass) or any non-cardiac major surgical procedure
* Known familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency (Fredrickson Type I), apolipoprotein C-II deficiency, or familial dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson Type III)
* Known hypersensitivity to the study product, fish and/or shellfish, or placebo
* History of acute or chronic pancreatitis
* Patients are excluded if using the following medications:

  * PCSK9 inhibitors
  * niacin \>200 mg/day or fibrates;
  * any omega-3 fatty acid medications ;
  * dietary supplements containing omega-3 fatty acids (e.g., flaxseed oil, fish oil, krill oil, or algal oil);
  * bile acid sequestrants
Brief summary: AMR101 (icosapent ethyl \[ethyl-EPA\]) is a highly purified ethyl ester of eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) developed by Amarin Pharma Inc. for the treatment of cardiovascular disease in statin-treated patients with hypertriglyceridemia. The purpose of this study was to evaluate whether this drug, combined with a statin therapy, will be superior to the statin therapy alone, when used as a prevention in reducing long-term cardiovascular events in high-risk patients with mixed dyslipidemia.
--- END ---
